scientific_integrity: An analytic proof of the stated local crossings for each fixed integer is supplied; finite checks are supplemental, not infinite-dimensional certificates.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric equal disks only; sufficiently small sizes depending on the resonance index, with no uniform threshold, no global classification, and residual historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Geometric-phase crossings of the maximal Gaussian localization eigenvalue on equilateral three-disk sets
